name: BUBO: Prologue
source:
A pair of mad scientists, Bubo and Aku Punk, celebrate their fifth anniversary working together and staying alive. Unfortunately, their luck could run out at any moment... Explore the different paths that reveal more about their relationship, and different ways they can die should they disturb the status quo.

[from [url=https://partulla.itch.io/bubo-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
